description: In-sandbox cron scheduler. Zero-dep cron parser + sweep loop dispatcher for the in-process schedule registry shipped by agent-base:secure. Persists task state at SCHEDULER_STATE_PATH (default /home/agent/scheduler/state.json). Bundles register cron-driven tasks; the agent itself owns the sweep tick (no external cron daemon, no cross-process trigger pipe). Composes with agent-base:secure — the registry there owns identity + audit; this layer owns when to fire.
